item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00145","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C23","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both proclamations concern a congressionally recognized international institution or event; their recitals describe the anticipated benefits and state that a joint resolution requests presidential recognition and federal assistance. Their operative clauses then call on government agencies to assist and cooperate, with the child adapting C04's international-participation language to Western Hemisphere nations. C23 and C02 share invitation-to-participate machinery but lack C04's distinctive combination of congressional recognition and federal agency cooperation.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the aforesaid joint resolution authorizes and requests the President ... to grant recognition to the Inter-American Cultural and Trade Center in Miami","parent_excerpt":"the aforesaid joint resolution requests the President to grant recognition to the World Metallurgical Congress ... and to call upon officials and agencies of the Government to assist and cooperate with such Congress","explanation":"Both use a recital identifying a joint resolution as the basis for presidential recognition of an international organization or gathering and governmental cooperation."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby call upon officials and agencies of the Government to assist and cooperate with the Inter-American Cultural and Trade Center","parent_excerpt":"I request that all Federal departments and agencies assist and cooperate with the World Metallurgical Congress","explanation":"The operative federal-assistance clause is materially and distinctively parallel, with the beneficiary changed."},{"child_excerpt":"I invite the participation of all the nations of the Western Hemisphere therein","parent_excerpt":"I also extend the welcome of this Government to the Congress and to the scientists attending its proceedings","explanation":"Both pair federal cooperation with an invitation or welcome directed to international participants."}]}
